snippet.title: NEW ANIMATION TOOLS! How to use Gartic Phone new resources
snippet.description:
Gartic Phone updates! : https://www.garticphone.com

Check out our new animation tools:
ps: These resources are available only for Animation and Movie modes:

EYEDROPPER TOOL
Use to get the color and opacity used in your drawing or in the previous one.

 HIDE/SHOW ONION SKIN
Click the button to disable the onion skin and see more clearly what you are drawing.

 NOTE TOOL
Use it to draw arrows or give directions to the next person. Your notes won't appear in your downloadable GIF.

 SETTINGS FOR SPEED AND LOOP IN ALBUM VIEW
Choose between five speed options and 3 types of loops to get the best result for your animation.

DRAWING PRESET
Start with the most used options in the previous frame and a visual separation of the colors used.
